content_sections.heading: About RITES and the Port of Colombo Assignment
content_sections.text: RITES Ltd. is a Navratna Central Public Sector Enterprise under the Ministry of Railways, Govt. of India. According to the REOI, it is a premier multi-disciplinary consultancy organization in the fields of transport, infrastructure and related technologies. Sri Lanka Ports Authority (the client) has invited proposals for consultancy services for the Preparation of a Land Use Optimization Study for the Port of Colombo. RITES has been shortlisted by the client to submit its Request for Proposal. The assignment comprises a land use survey of port and near-port land, followed by a Land Use Optimization Plan for short-, medium- and long-term port and port-related logistics development. It aims to optimize land utilization within the Port of Colombo, improving operational efficiency, logistics integration and future development planning. The empanelled Experts will be considered for deployment against suitable positions on this consultancy. The selection of a particular Expert will be made from the list of empanelled Experts, based on the project's qualification requirements and negotiation between RITES and the Expert.

content_sections.heading: RITES Experts Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be eligible, an applicant must meet the following conditions from the REOI: Possess the minimum qualification and experience for the proposed position as per Annexure-I (see the qualification section below). Be not more than 60 years of age as on the last date of submission of the EOI Application. Submit the application in the prescribed formats of Annexure-II along with all required documents. Not be blacklisted, debarred, banned or restricted by any Department of Central Govt., State Govt. or Central or State PSUs as on the date of submission. Any earlier blacklisting, debarment, ban or restriction must be disclosed in Form-II. The notification is open to International and National Experts. A copy of the passport is required with the application.

content_sections.heading: RITES Experts Selection Process
content_sections.text: The REOI does not mention a written test or interview. The process described is as follows: Examination of applications: RITES checks that all requested documents are provided and complete. It may ask applicants for clarifications within the time it specifies. Evaluation: RITES uses the inputs submitted in the Annexure-II forms and any clarifications. It also reserves the right to assess an applicant's capability and capacity to perform where circumstances warrant. Empanelment: After evaluation, applicants are empanelled and informed by e-mail. The first list is prepared from applications received up to 08.10.2026, 17:00 hrs, and expanded later at intervals decided by RITES. Project-wise shortlisting: While bidding for a project, RITES scrutinizes the CVs of empanelled Experts to judge suitability against the project's RFP requirements. Negotiation and consent: RITES interacts with shortlisted Experts, negotiates remuneration and obtains written consent before submitting the bid. Engagement: Once the project is awarded to RITES, the Experts whose CVs were used in the bid are engaged for the project. Mere empanelment does not guarantee a job with RITES Limited.

Avoid interlineations or overwriting; any correction made by the applicant must be initialled. content_sections.heading: Important Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: Misrepresentation: RITES treats the information supplied as correct and complete and does not separately verify it during evaluation. Any misrepresentation or incorrect statement found can lead to rejection of the application or cancellation of empanelment or engagement, with blacklisting or banning of business for a period of up to three years. Confidentiality: All information, documents, data and personal information related to the REOI are confidential. Any attempt to influence RITES in the evaluation may result in rejection of the application. Empanelment rights: RITES may suspend, remove or terminate the empanelment of any Expert at any time without assigning any reason. RITES may also cancel the empanelment process at any time and is not bound to accept any application or empanel any applicant. Governing law: The REOI is governed by the laws of India, and the Courts at Delhi have exclusive jurisdiction. Clarifications: Applicants may seek clarifications in case of doubt about the REOI.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES) for empanelment of experts under advertisement number RITES/AP/P&WR/EOI/Experts/2026/01.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in this notification?
faq.answer: The positions available include Port Planning Expert, Port Related Logistics Expert, and Transport Planner Expert, aimed at preparing a land use optimization study for the Port of Colombo.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the expression of interest application via email is 11 October 2026, with the first list of empanelment based on EOI applications expected by 08 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for RITES experts recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply exclusively through email. Applications and requisite documents must be sent to [email protected] with copies to designated email addresses.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Port Planning Expert?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Port Planning Expert role must possess a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering along with a minimum of 15 years of relevant sector experience.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for the Port Related Logistics Expert post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Master's degree or PG Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Port & Logistics Management, Port & Shipping Management, or Shipping Logistics with matching experience.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the Expression of Interest applications for these contract-based expert roles.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts under this recruitment notification is 60 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion before applying.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves the examination and evaluation of EOI applications, subsequent shortlisting and negotiation, followed by official empanelment by RITES.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official RITES website at www.rites.com to download the detailed recruitment notification and REOI document for complete instructions and guidelines.
